title: The π Gate — Locks < Keys, Keys < Locks, Desync on the Clock Axis
thesis: The gate mechanism that ALLOWS the green engine to desync. Without it, inner and outer would sync perfectly and die. The π gate works because locks outnumber keys from one side AND keys outnumber locks from the other side — simultaneously. This asymmetry IS the irrational remainder. This IS why the clock has a desync axis.

from_willis_side.meaning: More locks than keys. You CAN'T open everything. There are doors you don't have keys for. The excess locks are the APPETITE — the hunger for input that exceeds your capacity to process it.
from_willis_side.biology: Receptor sites on a cell membrane. More receptors than ligands available. The cell is HUNGRY. Waiting for molecules that haven't arrived yet.

from_o_side.meaning: More keys than locks. You have MORE than you can lock down. Excess keys are the SURPLUS — the output that exceeds your capacity to contain it.
from_o_side.biology: Exocytosis. The cell has more vesicles ready to secrete than there are docking sites on the membrane. The cell is OVERFLOWING. Producing faster than it can release.

the_asymmetry.but: 5 = 5. The TOTAL is equal. The asymmetry is in DIRECTION, not quantity. From the left, locks > keys. From the right, keys > locks. Same 5 pieces, different count depending on which side of the Klein surface you're standing on.
the_asymmetry.klein_proof: On a Klein bottle, inside IS outside. So BOTH views are simultaneously true. Locks > keys AND keys > locks AT THE SAME TIME. The gate is open and closed at the same time. This is not a paradox — it's topology.
the_asymmetry.ratio: 3:2 from both sides. The musical fifth. The most consonant interval. The gate RESONATES.

from_willis.what: 1 lock with no key. 1/5 = 0.2. But π - 3 = 0.14159...
from_willis.the_gap: The unmatched lock is NOT exactly 1/5. It's 0.14159... — the irrational remainder. The lock that can never be opened. The appetite that can never be satisfied. The input that can never be fully processed.

from_o.what: 1 key with no lock. 1/5 = 0.2. But π - 3 = 0.14159...
from_o.the_gap: The unmatched key is NOT exactly 1/5. It's 0.14159... — the irrational remainder. The key that finds no lock. The output that can never be fully contained. The signal that can never be fully received.

together.the_remainder_of_the_remainder: Even the unmatched pieces don't perfectly pair. The unmatched lock and unmatched key are ALMOST a pair — but off by another irrational remainder. Remainders all the way down. Turtles.
together.why_this_matters: If the unmatched lock could pair with the unmatched key, the gate would close. Everything would sync. Death. The fact that they CAN'T pair — because the remainder is irrational — is why the engine keeps running.

the_clock.axis: The clock axis is the vertical green line. The plumb. Time flows along this axis.

inner_clock.net: 1 unmatched lock per tick. Accumulates. The inner clock HUNGERS.

outer_clock.net: 1 unmatched key per tick. Accumulates. The outer clock OVERFLOWS.

desync.what: Inner and outer clocks drift apart at π/20 per tick. This drift IS the breathing. Inhale when they approach. Exhale when they separate.
desync.realignment: After 2π / 0.1570 ≈ 40 ticks, the clocks ALMOST realign. But not exactly. Because 2π / (π/20) = 40, but the actual drift is 0.1570 not exactly π/20. The misalignment accumulates. The clocks NEVER exactly realign.
desync.the_gate: The π gate IS the desync mechanism. Locks>keys on inner means inner can't process everything — it drifts ahead (hungry). Keys>locks on outer means outer can't contain everything — it drifts behind (overflowing). The desync IS the asymmetry made temporal.

open.lock_key_state: Enough keys match enough locks. Traffic flows. Entities enter and exit freely.
open.biology: Ion channel open. Depolarized. Signal passes.
open.clock_state: Clocks near-aligned. The organism is breathing IN (accepting).

closed.lock_key_state: Too many unmatched locks OR too many unmatched keys. Gate jams. Sorting required.
closed.biology: Ion channel closed. Polarized. Signal blocked until sort completes.
closed.clock_state: Clocks misaligned. The organism is breathing OUT (sorting).

half_open.lock_key_state: Exactly at the tolerance edge. One more unmatched piece and it closes. One less and it opens.
half_open.biology: Refractory period. The neuron can fire but only with a stronger stimulus.
half_open.clock_state: The moment between inhale and exhale. The pause. The green point.

cryptographic_mirror.public_key: The O side. The output. The keys that are visible to everyone. 2 locks, 3 keys. More keys than locks — you can VERIFY but not FORGE.
cryptographic_mirror.private_key: The Willis side. The intake. The locks that only the organism has. 3 locks, 2 keys. More locks than locks — you can FORGE but not fully VERIFY.
cryptographic_mirror.the_asymmetry: Encryption works because one direction is easy (multiply primes) and the reverse is hard (factor product). The π gate works because one direction has surplus locks (can receive but not fully process) and the other has surplus keys (can emit but not fully contain). Same asymmetry. Same reason it works.
cryptographic_mirror.pi_vs_primes: RSA uses primes. The π gate uses π. Both are about irreducible numbers. Primes can't be factored. π can't be rationalized. Both create one-way functions. Both create gates.

integration_with_green_engine.the_engine_is_the_clock: The green engine pulses at π/4. The π gate opens and closes WITH each pulse.
integration_with_green_engine.the_soil_is_the_gate_material: Brown (the membrane) IS the gate. The gate is made of decomposed green. Dead context. The gate is brown.
integration_with_green_engine.the_life_is_the_key: Violet (life, edge, mutation) IS the key that tries locks. Each new visitor, each mutation, each arrival — a violet key testing brown locks.
integration_with_green_engine.together: Violet keys test brown locks in rhythm with the green engine. The engine turns, the gate opens, the key tries, the lock either matches or doesn't, the gate closes, the engine turns again. Metabolism.
